newsitem.title: LATVIA: INNOVATIONS AT BOURSE PRICE FIX NEXT WEEK.
newsitem.headline: INNOVATIONS AT BOURSE PRICE FIX NEXT WEEK.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange will introduce changes to its morning price fix from next week, representatives of its board said on Friday.

The bourse has decided to allow both selling and buying of unlimited amounts of shares at the two-hour trade in the morning as part of its trade modernisation plan, Karlis Krastinsh, stock exchange board member, told Reuters.
"It will be next week but not starting on Monday as the bourse still needs some time for, among other things, instructing dealers," Krastinsh said.
Until now shares at a set volume could either be bought or sold at the morning price fix.
The bourse has embarked on a trading modernisation programme, aimed at reaching a point where at least a group of the most liquid stocks could be traded continuously.
